notepad_final:
L1 solved from reset: U,L,D,R,D,L. L1: 8=sliding blocks, 5=terrain, 0=empty; 10 fixed/special. Dead-end/L1 loss-adjacent HUD states seen: 7/7/5 and 7/5/5; all-5 HUD is losing.

L2: 10 appears movable under global tilts. UP-first branch explored heavily; seems cyclical, incl. a lower/right-shifted arrangement where UP and DOWN were no-ops.

Reset from L2 can sometimes return to L1, though recent resets from the cycle returned directly to fresh L2. Fresh L2 start: LEFT starts a distinct safe branch. In that left-first branch, DOWN and RIGHT were safe. That branch reached a distinct safe 7/7/5 arrangement with altered 8-cluster alignment; DOWN from that 7/7/5 safely changed it to 7/5/5. Important losses: from the left-first 7/5/5 state, one further DOWN led to GAME_OVER / 5/5/5, and UP from that same 7/5/5 basin also led to GAME_OVER / 5/5/5. So avoid both UP and DOWN there. Fresh LEFT can be visually subtle; LEFT then DOWN successfully re-reaches the known left-first 7/7/5 state. From that left-first 7/7/5 state, RIGHT and UP appeared to show no visible change, and repeated LEFT attempts also appear uninformative; DOWN is the reliable way back to the dangerous 7/5/5 basin. From the left-first 7/5/5 basin, RIGHT appears to restore the fresh 7/7/7 start safely; LEFT may also return to fresh / be subtle, so that basin is close to exhausted aside from known losing UP/DOWN.

Fresh L2 RIGHT branch: RIGHT then DOWN stayed safe and kept HUD 7/7/7 while shifting clusters right/lower. LEFT from that branch was safe and kept 7/7/7. UP from that branch changed HUD to 7/7/5; DOWN from that right-first 7/7/5 safely returned to 7/5/5. From that right-first-derived 7/5/5 basin, LEFT/UP/RIGHT showed no visible progress. Also a displayed 7/7/7 right-first-style basin with lowered/right-shifted 8-clusters appeared to cycle under UP/RIGHT/LEFT/DOWN.

Fresh-start DOWN from L2 appeared to be a no-op/no visible change.

If reset returns to fresh 7/7/7 again, prefer LEFT first; if LEFT is visually subtle, follow with DOWN to try to regain the known left-first 7/7/5 state. Current display at the end appears to be the left-first 7/5/5 basin; LEFT is the last untried non-losing local probe there.

L1: global block-shift puzzle. 8 movable, 10 fixed, 7 lives. Rebuild route from fresh reset to L2: left, down, right, down, left.

L2: 4x4 blue blocks in chambers. Critical: undo unsafe and does not restore life; reset during IN_PROGRESS may campaign-reset to L1/Score 0. From clean start, first down safe/repeatable; second down dangerous and can cost lives. Clean-start left/right mostly safe/no-op. Preferred policy: cautious horizontal probing; repeated right can shift some blocks one tile where space exists. In deeper branch after deliberate second-down, immediate horizontals were safe/low-impact. Up can be survivable and lifts lower placements upward, but some up tests can cost life. Current branch: only one visible life remains after later up from the post-up deep branch. Recent one-life left/right probes are all low-impact/no-loss and strongly suggest a local horizontal dead-end/toggle. Desperation observation: at least one controlled up from the one-life altered branch also appeared survivable/no visible life loss. With very little time left, up is the best remaining branch-change attempt if horizontals stay dead.

Top row lane: right converts one 12 into 6 from right to left and has remained the only safe move for most of the run. Up from the fresh reset also safely converted the far-right 12 to 6 once, so it may alias right or be context-dependent; this still needs testing near the end. Left from the active top-right state was fatal (likely reversing into occupied trail/body). Down from that state was also fatal, so adjacent 0-space off the lane is deadly. Undo reverts board position but not lives. HUD/lives are row 1 left; 7s turn to 5 after deaths. Lower field is a large 5-region with patches of 8 and 10 plus internal 0 gaps; meanings still unknown. Completing the top row entirely via right previously caused GAME OVER, and right with about 6 remaining was fatal and cost a life. Up at a near-end state with about 5 remaining 12s safely converted the rest to 6 while staying IN_PROGRESS, so likely use up instead of right at that endgame cluster. Pressing right from an all-6 top row was fatal and reset the board with a life loss. Current visual board still looks like an early rebuild again with many 12s remaining, so trust the grid and continue right until the top-row 12 cluster is small before using up. Step 199/current view still has many 12s, so continue right.
